meta.title: TodoLight
meta.description: A shared to-do board where teammates see and help with each other's tasks, all in one screen

resetRequest.title: Reset your password
resetRequest.description: We'll send a reset link to your email.
resetRequest.sentDescription: We sent a reset link to {email}. Open it to set a new password.
resetRequest.spamHint: Check spam if you don't see it. The link expires in an hour.

resetConfirm.title: New password
resetConfirm.description: Choose the password you'll use from now on.
resetConfirm.expiredLinkPrompt: Link expired? Get a new one
resetConfirm.linkExpiredError: That link expired. Please request a new reset email.

newOrg.title: Create an org
newOrg.description: You'll be the owner. Invite teammates by email afterward.

handoff.title: Handle for them
handoff.description: This is {owner}'s to-do. Leave a note on how you handled it.
handoff.placeholder: e.g. Emailed the client — will share once they reply.

board.noOrgDescription: Create an org and invite teammates, or accept an invite you've received.
board.soloDescriptionManager: Invite teammates and your to-dos will sit side by side.
board.soloDescriptionMember: Once the owner invites teammates, your to-dos will sit side by side.
board.askOwnerToInvite: Ask the owner to send an invite.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.disabledDescription: Turn it back on in your settings to use it again.
ledger.noOrgDescription: The ledger is kept per org too. Create one or accept an invite.

team.inviteDescription: Enter an email — they see the invite next time they log in.
team.discordDescription: New to-dos and handoffs post here. Leave blank to turn it off.
team.kickConfirmDetail: They'll lose access to this org's board. Their to-dos and notes stay as they are. You'd need to send a new invite to bring them back.

landing.tagline: The to-do list that shows your whole team on one page
landing.pointLightBody: No install, no setup — just an invite and you're in
landing.pointSimpleBody: Simple but powerful — see what your org needs to do
landing.pointFastBody: Checking a box updates the screen instantly

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, refresh the page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may have changed or this page may no longer exist.

toast.orgCreated: Org created. Now go invite your team.
toast.confirmEmailSent: We sent a confirmation email — please verify to finish.
toast.invalidCredentials: That email or password isn't right.

errors.notAMember: You're not a member of this org.
errors.managerOnly: Only the owner or an admin can do this.
errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like a valid email.
errors.alreadyMember: That person is already a member.
errors.noEmailForInvite: No email on file, so this invite can't be processed.
errors.cannotRemoveOwner: The owner can't be removed from the org.
errors.cannotChangeOwnRole: You can't change your own role.
errors.invalidDiscordWebhook: That's not a Discord webhook URL.
errors.invalidAvatarUrl: That profile picture address isn't valid.
errors.invalidOrgImageUrl: That org image address isn't valid.
errors.todoTitleRequired: Please enter what needs to be done.
errors.cannotDeleteTodo: Only the owner or a manager can delete this.
errors.cannotDeleteNote: You can only delete your own notes.
errors.cannotEditNote: You can only edit your own notes.
errors.alreadyJoined: You're already in on this one.
errors.cannotJoinOwnTodo: You can't join your own to-do.
errors.cannotDeleteEvent: Only the creator or a manager can delete this.
errors.ledgerTitleRequired: Say what the money went to.
errors.ledgerAmountRequired: Enter a whole amount greater than zero.
errors.cannotDeleteLedgerEntry: Only the person who logged or paid it, or an owner, can remove it.
